text: The actual1482 landing stores AccountConfig in #currentConfig and passes its incoming value to MsgAccountManager. Lessoncc579a8e1398c9f4dcbcdbeed4cfe70234a25460e958c6ffda228a9b94bdfd5b incorrectly says that landing introduced created-account state. At the fixed accepted endpoint, the normal success paths pass #account and the component reads incomingServer; the selected Encryption test expects that created account. The current discovery catch still passes #currentConfig, a separately recorded static concern without reproduced effect. Keep historical configuration, current account contract and fallback branch separate. No Account Hub or settings test ran.
